title: siaf-darkening: Analysis code for Arctic sea ice darkening SIAF decomposition
description: Analysis code for 'Sea Ice Darkening of Surviving Arctic Sea Ice Accelerates Radiative Forcing' (Rotondo et al.). Decomposes the Arctic sea ice albedo feedback (SIAF) into area-loss and ice-darkening components across satellite records (CLARA-A3, APP-x, NSIDC CDR) and 378 CMIP6 historical ensemble members using the APRP radiative sensitivity framework.
